answer.reason: The verses tell of Jotham judging the people while his father was a leper, building the high gate, and defeating the Ammonites.

clauses.english: judged the people of the land while his father was a leper
clauses.quote: Jotham the king's son was over the house, judging the people of the land

clauses.english: built the high gate of the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: He built the high gate of the house of the LORD

clauses.english: fought the Ammonites and prevailed against them
clauses.quote: He fought also with the king of the Ammonites, and prevailed against them.

doubts: Verses that only date prophets or events by Jotham's reign (ISA 1:1, HOS 1:1, MIC 1:1, 1CH 5:17, 2KI 15:30) and the genealogies (1CH 3:12, MAT 1:9) were left out.
The leprosy and the judging in 2KI 15:5 and 2CH 26:21 are told of Uzziah; only the part about Jotham is used.
